title: Elk Herd Roaming Farther: Reintroduced West Virginia animals test new range; tourism tours expand
summary_full: West Virginia's elk restoration initiative is flourishing, with the herd expanding to around 130 individuals alongside numerous native calves. Elk are venturing into new territories, showcasing a robust population increase. This revival not only highlights the animals' successful reintroduction into their habitat but also boosts local tourism, marking a remarkable triumph in wildlife conservation.
